method: Change-detection sweep against issuer pages (chase.com, creditcards.chase.com, media.chase.com, Chase AEM disclosure fragments, americanexpress.com, capitalone.com, delta.com, marriott.com, hilton.com, united.com, hyatt.com/newsroom.hyatt.com, ihg.com, southwest.com, thecenturionlounge.com, instacart.com Chase co-brand pages, Chase/DoorDash co-brand terms), run by four parallel per-issuer agents against the 2026-08-17 baseline. NO issuer-side benefit change found on any of the 17 cards for the SEVENTH consecutive pass; all 16 issuer-confirmable annual fees re-confirmed unchanged from page headers (Ritz $450 remains the sole unconfirmable fee). What changed is our record: 188 -> 202 benefits, 14 additions and 30 corrections. HEADLINE -- A SYNC GAP, NOT A DISCOVERY: this pass independently re-derived that the CSR Marriott Gold fast-track (the nearest date in this system, 9/30/26) is UNUSABLE, via Chase's controlling AEM disclosure -- "by invitation only" and "Existing Marriott Bonvoy members with Gold Elite status or higher Elite status are not eligible." CRITICALLY: the Notion tracker ALREADY recorded this as resolved on 8/19/26; this JSON dataset and the site did not, and had been carrying the 9/30 deadline as live for five days. The real finding is that Notion and the site had diverged. Now reconciled. THIRD REVERSAL: Delta Reserve Business companion-certificate cabin eligibility. We recorded Delta Premium Select as eligible on the authority of delta.com/resbizbenefitterms. Root cause of that page's three-pass failure is now known -- it is not a JS shell, it 302s to an Amex print route returning HTTP 404, and the Gold/Platinum/Bonvoy equivalents 404 identically. Both LIVE issuer pages say only "Delta First, Delta Comfort, or Delta Main" with ZERO occurrences of "Premium Select" (and zero of "Delta One", so our "excludes only Delta One" line was never issuer text either). Downgraded to confirm-at-booking. Companion taxes corrected from our $80/$250 split to the issuer's actual "$22 and $250 (for itineraries with up to four flight segments)". Chase's pages for those three still show zero Instacart content (4 raw hits each, all hamburger-nav chrome). The +$360/yr stands, still flagged verify-at-enrollment. OTHER MATERIAL CORRECTIONS: Priority Pass is AUTO-ACTIVATED on CSR, CSR Business and Ritz -- we had all three flagged enroll-required; Apple TV dates on CSR (6/22/27) and CSP (12/31/26) are ACTIVATION deadlines, not service end dates, with 12 months running from activation; CSR Peloton 10x is capped at $5,000 of purchases; ZipRecruiter ends 12/31/27 and GiftCards.com ends 10/31/28 (the only 2028 date in the dataset); the Hyatt 4:3 cut is scoped to Sapphire Preferred and Ink Business Preferred ONLY, with different timing for each. Ritz Global Entry cadence and Ritz DoorDash tier are both flagged as our inference. Southwest Performance Business DashPass rests on absence from an exclusion list, now flagged. Aspire's ZZAAP1 phone code is retired in favour of 855-292-5757. OPEN ITEMS CLOSED: Lufthansa lounge removal is an AUSTRALIAN-market change only, zero occurrences on the U.S. Business Platinum page -- item retired. Ritz $450 fee recommended for retirement as unresolvable after 12 failed routes. RE-CONFIRMED NEGATIVES: American Airlines is still NOT a Capital One transfer partner (page still dated 2026-01-29, 18 airlines + 4 hotels, refuted a SIXTH time, this pass with a byte-level negative check against a working control term); Delta Reserve Business still has no CLEAR and no airline-fee credit; Hilton Aspire still has no lounge access and no Global Entry credit, confirmed by complete enumeration of Amex's 25-item list; Hyatt Explorist at $50k is still on no Chase page (zero "Explorist" occurrences); Southwest's retired $75 credit and upgraded boardings are still gone; Business Gold's FedEx exit is still on schedule for 10/01/2026, character-for-character.
